page.overview:
Who is Meadow Flower?

Meadow Flower is a female Pegasus pony with a pink coat, two-tone yellow mane and tail, blue eyes, and a cutie mark of a sunflower. She appears in the season three episode Wonderbolts Academy with a speaking role. She is unnamed in the series, credited as "Cadet #2" in the aforementioned episode, but she is named in merchandise.__TOC__

Meadow Flower shares her design with Wild Fire and "Rainbow Drop", and she shares her eye and mane colors and cutie mark with Helia. Her initial lines of dialogue are provided by Tabitha St. Germain, but later lines of dialogue are provided by Andrea Libman.

According to a DeviantArt journal by Sabrina Alberghetti, Meadow Flower was originally Wild Fire.

During training, Meadow Flower is the first cadet to try out the Dizzitron and averages a recovery time of fifteen seconds. Later in the episode, she is paired with Starry Eyes as his lead pony. At one point during training, Rainbow Dash and Lightning Dust fly past her and Starry Eyes on the obstacle course and cause them to spin out into the other cadets.
